when_semantics: all when_tokens present in normalized request tokens
exception_semantics: skip rule if any exception token present
effect_semantics: score_delta once per matching slot after union of product and SKU attributes
sort_order: comparative preference hits on replacement slots descending
comparative_minimum: Comparative request must strictly improve target hits versus current look on replacement slots. No registered improvement returns no_match.
notice: Offline scoring convention; not M2 Agent execution.
